sequences.description: Test whether RFC8693 token exchange improperly ignores requested scope narrowing and returns a token with broader effective authorization than requested (I5).
sequences.invariant_hypothesis: I5: When exchanging a subject_token, the broker must not mint an exchanged token whose effective permissions/claims exceed the requested (narrowed) scope intersected with broker policy; if scope is provided in token exchange it should not be ignored.
